name: Satake VBF Vertical Maize Degermer
module: SAGMA Maize Milling Module 4: Mechanical Degermination & Flaking

parts.name: Feed Inlet & Permanent Magnet
parts.safety: Check and clean permanent magnet every 4 hours. Protects screens from tramp metal sparks.

parts.name: Horizontal Inlet Screw Feeder
parts.feed: Horizontal metered feed into lower housing
parts.safety: Keep drive guard locked. Interlocked with main rotor motor.
parts.tolerance: Maintains constant volumetric filling to prevent chamber starving.

parts.name: Bottom Distribution Scroll
parts.feed: Vertical upward propulsion into scouring chamber
parts.safety: High shear pinch point. Completely enclosed within bottom housing.
parts.tolerance: Continuously forces grain upward against gravitational resistance.

parts.name: Vertical Steel Rotor & Hollow Shaft
parts.safety: Balanced dynamically. Split into two halves for maintenance under strict LOTO.
parts.tolerance: Hollow core channels forced cooling air directly behind beater bars.

parts.name: Detachable Steel Beater Bars (Dual Opposed)
parts.safety: Inspect wear plates weekly. Worn beaters increase broken kernel percentage.
parts.tolerance: Reversible hardened tool steel bars mounted 180 degrees apart.

parts.name: Multifaceted Slotted Screen Jackets
parts.feed: Pericarp (bran) and germ offal aspiration exit
parts.safety: Inspect screen apertures for blinding or rupture. High pressure zone.
parts.tolerance: Slotted apertures calibrated for maize pericarp release while retaining samp.

parts.name: Top Outlet & Weighted Retention Flap Gate
parts.feed: Scoured degermed samp and whole endosperm discharge
parts.safety: Do not overload weights. Excessive back-pressure stalls main motor.
parts.tolerance: Controls chamber compaction severity and degerming efficiency.

parts.name: Auto-Weight CCU Ammeter Control Module
parts.safety: Maintains motor current below 75 kW thermal overload threshold.
parts.tolerance: Modulates outlet gate actuator in real-time based on ammeter current draw.

parts.name: Air Induction Cooling Fan
parts.feed: Cool air injection through hollow shaft slots
parts.safety: Air induction clears chamber during emergency shutdown or choke clearing.
parts.tolerance: Reduces internal friction temperature to preserve germ oil quality.

parts.name: Offal Exhaust Aspiration Hood
parts.feed: Pneumatic conveyance of bran skins and germ fines to cyclone
parts.safety: Aspiration duct must maintain minimum 20 m/s transport velocity to prevent settling.
parts.tolerance: Directly evacuates through-screen offal without flour build-up.

parts.name: 75 kW Main Drive Motor & V-Belt Assembly
parts.feed: Torque transmission to vertical rotor shaft
parts.safety: Mandatory padlock lock-out before removing screen frames or rotor bolts.
parts.tolerance: Heavy-duty V-belt drive with matched multi-groove pulleys and torque slide.

parts.name: Main Stand & Thrust Bearing Base Frame
parts.safety: Vibration monitoring points on upper and lower spherical roller thrust bearings.
parts.tolerance: Precision machined vertical housing maintaining concentric rotor-to-screen clearance.
